newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bankers Trust expands Israel operations.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust expands Israel operations.

text.p: Bankers Trust Co said on Wednesday it was expanding its operations in Israel and appointing Gary Kaufman as vice president of its Tel Aviv office.
Kaufman will be responsible for client advisory and capital markets activities, including debt and equity underwriting, sales and trading, risk management products and corporate finance advisory.
"We see Israel as one of the most important Middle Eastern markets of the next five years," Ron Gutler, head of Bankers Trust's operations in Israel, said in a statement.
Bankers Trust has been active in Israel for 20 years, offering correspondent banking and global custody services. The Tel Aviv office, headed by Ron Gutler, was opened in 1994.
